items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1961-05-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That fellow John Selter. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. He's a young trumpet player. Mm-hm. And he plays exactly like I played. [INTERVIEWEE] He surprised me .

ctx.x: Well, no, because you get your breaks. Well, the only thing, well, you'd expect that, is when you get the breaks you have the autographs and this and talk to that one or two at that time, and you're supposed to get a rest, which you don't. You know. That's in the game. Did you know that New Orleans jazz was so popular in Europe? I didn't. And that people really started it then? I was surprised when I heard the fellas play so wonderful.
Most of the people knew your name? Yeah, they did. That fellow John Selter. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. He's a young trumpet player. Mm-hm. And he plays exactly like I played.
